message: Security definition should have a description.
OperationId has a noun 'Widget' that conflicts with a model name. The model will be disambiguated to 'WidgetModel' in generated SDKs. Consider using the plural form to avoid this.
Path parameter should specify a maximum length (maxLength) and characters allowed (pattern).
Please provide x-ms-examples describing minimum/maximum property set for response/request payloads for operations.
